text:
Renee Park: Heads-up from onboarding: Kaito at OmniCart says their bulk data import (CSV->embedding batch) failed with a "presigned URL expired" error, so their index never finished. Theyre worried this looks like a product bug for their trial.
Diego Morales: Thanks, Renee. Scope? How many accounts and is the raw upload lost or just the import step?
Renee Park: Two trial accounts and one sandbox tenant affected. Files uploaded to S3 successfully, but our importer tried to fetch the objects after the presigned URLs expired. So data still in S3 but not processed.
incident-bot: Incident OP-2026-35 created (import-presign-expiry). Priority: P3.
Diego Morales: Good to know it's recoverable. Customer comms should: acknowledge, confirm data intact, explain short cause (presigned URL TTL too short for queued imports), state remediation (re-ingest and manual prioritization), and offer a migration assist + small credit. Keep it short and action-oriented.
Renee Park: Draft message to Kaito: "Hi Kaito — thanks for flagging. Your uploaded files were intact but our processing job attempted to fetch them after the presigned URLs expired, so the import failed. Weve queued a re-ingest for your files and prioritized it; we can also run a manual migration of your dataset this afternoon if youd like. As an apology weve added a $300 one-time credit and a dedicated 30-minute migration session. Reply if you want us to proceed now"
Kaito (OmniCart): That sounds perfect. Can you guarantee we wont lose ordering or metadata?
Diego Morales: Yes — metadata is preserved in the upload manifest; re-ingest will use the same manifest, preserving ordering. Well also snapshot the bucket before reprocessing. Lina, can you run the prioritized job and snapshot?
Lina (Provision): On it. Command Ill run: `./jobs/reprocess_import --tenant omni-42 --manifest s3://onboard/omni-42/manifest.json --priority high --snapshot-before=true`
Renee Park: I'll send the approved customer note now and schedule the migration session for 3pm JST.
incident-bot: Reprocess job queued (job id rp-2026-901).
Lina (Provision): Snapshot completed, reprocess started. Monitoring ingestion metrics now.
Kaito (OmniCart): Thanks team. Appreciate the credit and session. Please include my engineers in the session invite.
Diego Morales: Post-action items: 1) Update presign TTL for onboarding flows from 1h to 6h for large uploads and add retry logic. 2) Add validation in the queued job to check presign validity before scheduling. Assign eng-platform for next sprint.
Renee Park: Notifying renewals@ since OmniCart is mid-trial and this could affect conversion. Logged the $300 credit and migration session.
Lina (Provision): Reprocess succeeded for two accounts; import metrics show 100% of objects processed and embedding index built.
Renee Park: Sending final status to Kaito now: "Resolved — imports completed and index built. Weve applied the $300 credit and shared the calendar invite for the migration walkthrough. Please reply if anything looks off and well escalate."
Kaito (OmniCart): Confirmed receipt and index looks good. Thanks for moving fast.
Diego Morales: Add acceptance test to onboarding e2e: simulate long delay between upload and processing to ensure presigned URLs survive or job retries. Assign to eng-infra.
Renee Park: Closing loop: detection +10m, customer comm +20m, reprocess started +35m, success +55m, credit applied +60m. Will attach a 48h RCA draft to customer thread. :white_check_mark:
